name: Shenzhen Feima International Supply Chain Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Feima International Supply Chain Co., Ltd. engages in the supply chain management and environmental protection new energy businesses in China and internationally. The company offers supply chain outsourcing services for non-core businesses such as customs clearance, warehousing, transportation, settlement, and procurement of large-scale special-shaped equipment for coal, non-ferrous metals, IT electronics, large-scale special-shaped equipment, etc. It is also involved in the treatment and utilization of solid waste renewable resources, such as waste power generation business; construction of industrial parks; and multi-port import and export business.
